description: Waze 5.28.5.0 (ARM64). Eight independent options: selectable map themes; selectable report icon packs; detailed report icons at normal sizes; local rank badge selector; unlock driver moods; Android Auto setup; adjustable Android Auto police alert distance; speed camera sound below the speed limit. Support Waze's inherited protobuf mood catalogue loader while retaining the older JNI layout. Include hidden moods through verified bridges that preserve sorting, caller registers and native results. Validate real catalogue calls, malformed and ambiguous bindings, range encoding and repeat application before and after patching. Add the Waze 5.28.5.0 compatibility fixture. Older inlined native icon sizing remains unsupported. Phone and Android Auto runtime testing is still required.

patches.name: Android Auto police alert distance
patches.description: Add a saved 50 to 10000 metre police/enforcement heads-up distance in Map display. Defaults to 1200 metres. Applies and verifies Waze's three native distance settings, with an original-distance restore option.

patches.name: Android Auto setup
patches.description: Bundle Waze AA Installer and add setup to Map display, with an offer after login. Requires Shizuku for the visibility repair.

patches.name: Detailed report icons at normal sizes
patches.description: Keep specific hazard icons when zooming out, using Waze's original small and tiny sizes. ARM64 only. Use alone or together with Selectable report icon packs from this bundle.

patches.name: Rank badge selector
patches.description: Add a persistent badge appearance selector to the Mood screen: crown, sword, shield, editor, wings, none or automatic. Local display only; account rank and what other users receive are unchanged.

patches.name: Selectable map themes
patches.description: Add a Themes selector below Dark mode with separate original, Google Maps and OLED choices for light and dark mode.

patches.name: Selectable report icon packs
patches.description: Add an Icon pack selector for original or Google Maps report icons. Defaults to Google Maps unless a choice is saved. Works independently of map themes and icon sizing.

patches.name: Speed camera sound below speed limit
patches.description: Enable Waze's speed camera sound below the speed limit. Reapplies after configuration updates. Camera alerts and audible sound must remain enabled in Waze.

patches.name: Unlock driver moods
patches.description: Unlock the mood picker, including Robot, 8-bit, Dino and beta moods, and expose special/hidden moods present in the local catalogue. Does not grant editor permissions or download unavailable campaigns.

release_notes:

selectable themes, selectable report icon packs, detailed report icon sizing,

Support Waze's inherited protobuf mood catalogue loader while retaining the older JNI layout. Include hidden moods through verified bridges that preserve sorting, caller registers and native results. Validate real catalogue calls, malformed and ambiguous bindings, range encoding and repeat application before and after patching. Add the Waze 5.28.5.0 compatibility fixture. Older inlined native icon sizing remains unsupported. Phone and Android Auto runtime testing is still required.

All eight patches applied; bundle structure, signing, version metadata and
16 KiB ZIP alignment were checked. Automated builds are not device-runtime tested.

The patched APK uses this repository's persistent signing key; an existing
installation signed by another key cannot be updated with it.
